thread:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — trying to lock the benchmark narrative for next week's webinar and the launch post. Goal: one crisp latency vs cost story + 2 supporting charts. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Omar Patel: Love that. My vote: lead with a simple latency vs $/token scatter (real workloads), then a throughput per-dollar bar, and a tail-latency cumulative curve for SLAs. Keep slide copy <60 chars.
Chris Nguyen: agree on the three. Can we also show an example routing policy implication? small callout: "choose small model variant for 95th pct target".
Mia Chen: yes. Want 1 slide that says: "Pick performance profile by latency SLO" with 3 micro-scenarios. Short bullets.
Sophia Li: I'll draft the micro-scenarios. Suggest labels: "Breadcrumb search (low latency)", "Customer support (balanced)", "Batch summarization (throughput)".
Omar Patel: For the scatter, we should overlay quantization choices as shape (circle/square) and annotate one or two anchor points. Example copy: "Open model X (int8) delivers 35ms @ $0.002/token"
Chris Nguyen: can someone pull the latest bench CSV? I can make the viz if I have the data by EOD today.
bench-bot: benchmark dataset updated: s3://redwood-bench/2026-03-21/trimmed.csv (rows: 43).
Mia Chen: thanks bench-bot. Chris — if you can mock up basic charts, we'll hand to design for polish.
Chris Nguyen: will do. Quick Q on copy tone: lean technical or customer-facing?
Sophia Li: for webinar — technical but accessible. For launch post — customer-facing (short, benefit-first).
Omar Patel: inbound routing note: we should tag leads by interest (low-latency, cost-sensitive, enterprise-SLA) so SDRs can pick the right playbook. Add a hidden form field on webinar RSVP.
Mia Chen: good call. Sophia, can you add those three buckets to registration flow?
Sophia Li: yes. I'll add: latency_slo, cost_priority, enterprise (checkbox).
Chris Nguyen: chart labels I plan to use (quick):
```
x-axis: median latency (ms)
y-axis: $ per 1k tokens
shape: quantization (fp16/int8)
color: model family
annotation: recommended route (hosted/dedicated/private)
```
Mia Chen: perfect. Add a tiny legend explaining routing implications.
Omar Patel: callout copy suggestions for social: "See how performance tradeoffs map to dollars — and pick the model that fits your SLA." Shorten as needed.
Sophia Li: Draft CTA options: "See the benchmark", "Find your SLO", "Book a capacity consult".
Mia Chen: Priority order for slides: 1) one-line thesis + scatter 2) throughput per-dollar bar 3) tail latency curve + routing implications 4) CTA/next steps.
Chris Nguyen: I'll upload mock PNGs to the thread by 17:30 PT.
Mia Chen: who owns the launch post write?
Omar Patel: I'll take the first draft, Sophia will edit for tone, then Chris adds chart assets.
Sophia Li: timeline OK: draft by tomorrow noon, design polish by day after, publish day after that (gives ops time to update docs).
Mia Chen: ace. Small ask for webinar script — include one slide with a short demo-run showing latency under load (screenshot + numbers). Omar/Chris — sync on which model variant to demo?
Chris Nguyen: propose demo on an open model int8 variant and then show a dedicated configuration with lower tail latency. Simple two-pane visual.
Omar Patel: fine with that. I'll coordinate demo infra.
Mia Chen: thanks all. I'll update this thread with a checklist once we have Chris's images. :thumbsup:
Mia Chen: (follow-up) also consider an email drip post-webinar with the 3-segment messaging Sophia mentioned.
Sophia Li: noted. I'll stub the email copy after the landing is live.
